note: WP-7 unit side (mutate-multi.js list key 'wp7-unit', proof null: jest --runTestsByPath the named suite under the proof lock, no database). Mocked-Prisma suites are not certification evidence (plan section 1.4): these entries only show that the unit gate also turns red beside the live catch. Unit catchers exist only for three OPTIONAL rule mutants (M-WF, M-PROOF, M-CUM), all in src/services/__tests__/eot-traceability.test.js (untouched by the HR-X1 batch); the section 6.2 guards M-70 and M-STAT have none (noUnitCatcher). Each entry's tests are the titles that must fail; every title was checked to exist in its suite at HEAD (mutsyntax-wp7.js). The unmutated suite must pass first (WP7-RUN-PLAN.md section 7.4). Run one id per invocation, quoted and with a trailing comma ("--only=M-STAT,") and always with --lists=<key>: mutate-multi.js matches a value without a comma as a PREFIX (M-70 would also match an M-70b; WP-4's M-LOCK also M-LOCKa and M-LOCKb), PowerShell drops an unquoted trailing comma, and ids such as M1 or G1 repeat across other lists.
noUnitCatcher: M-70 (the 70% boundary), M-ALLOW, M-NC: no unit suite exercises listWeatherDelays (weather.service.js has no __tests__ suite; project-route-guards.test.js mocks the whole service; the daily-log weather case mocks weatherService). Live catchers W.T7.a20at14 / a30at21 / a10at7 (and the optional ones' W.T7.*) only.

M-STAT (the approved-EOT lock, status half): no case moves an approved claim. 'submits EOT claims through the workflow endpoint and blocks direct approvals' asks draft -> approved without an action on an existing status draft, which M-STAT leaves guarded; 'approves submitted EOT claims with revised completion recommendation metadata' starts from submitted. Live catchers T1.T7.patchApprovedToDraft / rejectApproved only.

M-REASON: no case sends a rejection without a reason: eot-traceability.test.js never calls rejectEotClaim; module-action-permissions.test.js mocks eot.service and sends a reason. Live catcher T1.T7.rejectWithoutReason only.
M-70b, M-REASONsvc: equivalent, not run (their lists' equivalent[]).
